title: Graduate Civil Engineer
content_text:
WML Consulting Engineers careers page (verified 4 Oct 2026). Graduate Civil Engineer Full Time West Perth. Kickstart your engineering career with WML Consultants. Motivated Graduate Civil Engineer to join West Perth team. Hands-on experience across civil infrastructure and land development projects. Mentoring from concept to construction.

What You Will Do: Design roads, intersections, drainage, and earthworks; Prepare engineering drawings, reports, and documentation; Conduct site support and construction inspections; Assist with technical assessments and project coordination; Liaise with clients, contractors, and authorities; Collaborate with Civil, Structural, Geotechnical, and Pavements teams.

What You Need: A Bachelor of Engineering (Civil) or equivalent (graduated or graduating in 2026); Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills; Enthusiastic, practical, solutions-focused approach; Strong desire to learn and collaborate; Vacation work or internship experience desirable but not essential.

What We Offer: Full exposure to project lifecycle; Direct mentorship; Clear career progression in a supportive multi-disciplinary firm.

To apply: send cover letter and resume to careers@wml.com.au (specify position and location in the subject line).

Also listed on same page: Graduate Civil Engineer Full Time Bunbury (recently completed or soon to complete degree in civil engineering), apply careers@wml.com.au. Offices Bunbury, Perth, Kalgoorlie.
apply_instructions: Email cover letter and resume to careers@wml.com.au specifying Graduate Civil Engineer and West Perth (or Bunbury) in the subject line.
